question: Which compound did FTIR suggest forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer crystal, and in what temperature range does TGA show the extra mass-loss step attributed to it?
rendered:
According to the document, FTIR suggests that cyanuric acid (CYA) forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer crystal. 

TGA shows the extra mass-loss step attributed to CYA in the temperature range of 200−250 °C.
